paper.title_en: Geodesic completeness, curvature singularities and infinite tidal forces
paper.abstract_en: We report some new findings regarding the subtle relations among geodesic completeness, curvature singularities and tidal forces. It is well known that any particle may be torn up near a singularity at the center of a black hole due to the divergent tidal force. However, we find that singularity is not the only cause of tidal force divergence. Even on the surface of the Earth, the tidal force experienced by a particle could be arbitrarily large if the particle moves arbitrarily close to the speed of light in a nonradial direction. Moreover, we find that the maximum tidal force always occurs along the radial direction, regardless of the particle's motion. Usually, a curvature singularity implies geodesic incompleteness since in many cases the metric cannot be defined at the location of the singularity. Counterexamples have been found in recent years, suggesting that geodesics could pass through curvature singularities. By taking into account the fact that any real particle is an extended body, we calculate the tidal force acting on the particle in a static and spherically symmetric spacetime. We explicitly show that an infinite tidal force always occurs near such a singularity. Therefore, no particle can actually reach the curvature singularity even if the metric is well defined at that point. We also demonstrate that the tidal acceleration along a null geodesic at the coordinate origin is divergent. Finally, we examine a wormhole solution which possesses a curvature singularity at its throat and was previously asserted to be geodesically complete in the literature. However, we prove that no metric can be defined at the throat and thus the spacetime is geodesically incomplete. we also show that the tidal forces experienced by any particle near the singularity are divergent.

decision.title_zh: 测地线完备性、曲率奇点与无限潮汐力
decision.abstract_zh: 我们报告了一些关于测地线完备性、曲率奇点与潮汐力之间微妙关系的新发现。众所周知，任何粒子都可能在黑洞中心的奇点附近因发散的潮汐力而被撕裂。然而，我们发现奇点并不是潮汐力发散的唯一致因。即使在地球表面，如果粒子以接近光速的速度沿非径向运动，其所受的潮汐力也可能任意大。此外，我们发现无论粒子如何运动，最大潮汐力总是沿径向方向出现。通常，曲率奇点意味着测地线不完备，因为在许多情况下，度规在奇点位置无法定义。近年来已发现反例，表明测地线可能穿过曲率奇点。考虑到任何真实粒子都是延展体，我们计算了静态球对称时空中粒子所受的潮汐力。我们明确证明，在这种奇点附近总是会出现无限大的潮汐力。因此，即使度规在该点有良好定义，也没有粒子能够真正到达曲率奇点。我们还证明了沿零测地线在坐标原点处的潮汐加速度是发散的。最后，我们检验了一个虫洞解，该解在其喉部具有曲率奇点，并且先前文献中声称其测地线完备。然而，我们证明了在喉部无法定义任何度规，因此时空是测地线不完备的。我们还表明，任何粒子在奇点附近所受的潮汐力都是发散的。
